name: Layeredy Announce
author: layeredysoftware

sections.description: Create beautiful announcement bars in one line of code. Let your entire community know what’s happening with customizable designs and scheduled campaigns. Designed for Announce by Layeredy Software (lyrdy.co/announce) This plugin connects to the Announce API to display announcements. Upon loading, the plugin fetches the latest status and content from the service, which is provided by Layeredy Software. For more information, see https://layeredy.com/announce. For Terms & Privacy please see https://layeredy.com/terms & https://layeredy.com/privacy.
